notes: Diagnosis metrics are computed from a real public e-commerce dataset (UCI Online Retail II, CC BY 4.0). Experiment results are computed from simulated sessions generated by scripts/simulate.py with the parameters documented in docs/SIMULATION.md, and are labelled 'simulated'. No figure in this file is hand-written.

real_events.definition: Event rows imported from the real dataset.

real_purchase_lines.definition: Purchase events, one per invoice line.

real_orders.definition: Distinct invoices; one invoice is one session.

real_anonymous_line_share.definition: Share of purchase lines with no customer id. Kept, not dropped, so revenue reconciles; excluded from RFM.

real_gross_revenue.definition: SUM(price * quantity) over real purchase lines, before returns.

real_return_lines.definition: Cancellation lines from the source, used for the return-rate guardrail.

catalog_products.definition: Products derived from the real dataset.

catalog_categorised_share.definition: Share of products a category rule matched. The rest stay 'uncategorised' rather than being forced into a bucket.

catalog_brand_coverage.definition: Share of products with a brand. The source carries none, so this is 0 by construction and is a genuine finding for the Phase 8 readiness score.

catalog_gtin_coverage.definition: Share of products with a GTIN.

catalog_image_coverage.definition: Share of products with an image.

simulated_events.definition: Event rows generated by the session simulator.

simulated_configured_relative_lift.definition: Relative conversion lift the simulator was CONFIGURED to produce, as an exact population parameter. The Experiment Studio never reads this; it must recover it from the generated events. See docs/SIMULATION.md.

funnel_conversion_rate.definition: Sessions that reached purchase, divided by all sessions.

funnel_aov.definition: Total revenue divided by the number of orders.

funnel_revenue_per_visitor.definition: Total revenue divided by all sessions, converting or not.

funnel_cart_abandonment_rate.definition: Sessions that added to cart but never purchased, divided by sessions that added to cart.

funnel_search_to_purchase_rate.definition: Sessions that used search AND purchased, divided by sessions that used search.

funnel_worst_step.definition: Funnel step losing the largest share of the sessions that reached it.

funnel_worst_step_drop_rate.definition: Share of sessions lost at the worst funnel step.

friction_top_step.definition: Transition carrying the most estimated revenue loss.

friction_top_share_of_loss.definition: Share of all modelled revenue loss attributable to the worst step.

segment_top_by_revenue.definition: RFM segment holding the largest share of revenue.

segment_top_revenue_share.definition: Share of revenue held by the largest RFM segment.

segment_top_customer_share.definition: Share of customers in the largest-revenue RFM segment.
